bullets: Ryley names the deck in the video's first line (t=766-767): "With the final deck here, we have Hog Executioner Tornado", and frames it as heritage - "this deck is kind of iconic, honestly. This is the deck that um a lot of pro players kind of came up using" (t=793-798). This game is the fifth and last deck of a Hero Valkyrie showcase video.

The hero slot is the point of the build: "this is probably the first deck that I thought of when I thought of the Hero Valkyrie. I feel like the Valkyrie works nicely with Tornado anyway" (t=773-776). Counting Wild Whirlwind, the Valkyrie is a 4 + 3 elixir card and he treats the ability as an optional spend - declined at t=806 ("I want an ability, but it's not worth it"), used at t=898, t=937 and t=1029.

Piloted as pure defence-into-chip against Miner Wall Breakers: Goblins pre-placed at (1,7)/(1,6)/(1,5) for the Miner, Executioner behind at (2,7)/(2,8) for the Evo Bats, Tornado at (9,8) to activate his King Tower off the Wall Breakers (t=846, "Great King Tower activation"), and bare bridge Hogs at (16,15) whenever the opponent had committed elixir. Regulation ended 0-0 on crowns - "we haven't really got any damage outside of like one hog rider shot" (t=954).

It won in triple-elixir overtime on the damage tiebreak: a Valkyrie plus Hog Rider at the left bridge at t=1024.8-1027.8 with the ability held for the tower fight ("go for the Valkyrie hog rider here. I'm going to go for the ability ice spirit here") drove the enemy left tower from 1654 to 822 HP while his own lowest tower sat at 1749. "Let's go. Very nice win" (t=1051).

Deck note: Tornado and Rocket are agent corrections to the automatic read, which had listed the opponent's Miner and Bomb Tower instead - Tornado is confirmed by own-side deploy labels and by the deck name he speaks aloud; Rocket is inferred from a continuous fourth hand slot and "I think I'm going to start rocket cycling" (t=1005) and was never deployed. new_deck.rationale: Every card except the Hog Rider is a defensive answer - Executioner and Tornado for swarms, Valkyrie for ground pushes, Goblins and Ice Spirit as cheap resets - and the win condition is repeated bridge Hog chip plus Rocket cycling rather than a build-up push.
new_deck.why_it_works_md: The Executioner + Tornado core answers everything the deck is otherwise weak to: the Tornado groups swarms into a single axe pass and doubles as a King Tower activator against Wall Breakers and other cheap ground threats. The Hero Valkyrie replaces the usual mini-tank with a card that both survives on defence and threatens the tower on the counterattack, and her Wild Whirlwind is an optional 3 elixir you spend only to win a specific fight - Ryley declines it as often as he uses it. Ice Spirit, Goblins and The Log give the deck a cheap enough cycle to keep the Executioner and Tornado available every push, and Goblins pre-placed behind the tower is a standing answer to Miner-style chip. Offence is deliberately thin: bare Hog Riders at the bridge to force out a building, with Rocket as the overtime finisher when the ground stalls.
